steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the tenant configuration required for the saved draft scenario.
Apply the case's required stage-addition configuration.
Confirm the Events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first saved draft shown in the Drafts list.
Open the draft's participant view, where the All Vendors window is available.
Confirm that the All Vendors window opened.
Check one of the vendor-list values expected by the case.
Check that the expected city value is visible in the vendor list.
Check another expected city value in the vendor list.
Open the vendor filtering controls requested by the case.
Record every filter control, field, option, disabled state, and visible message after Filters is opened.

args.goal: Review the open All Vendors filter controls, apply an available visible value such as Closed or City Aalborg when offered, and record whether the vendor list changes and what message or result appears; stop on the filtered All Vendors result.

steps.note: Exercise the dynamically rendered filter UI and observe the resulting list or message without inventing control labels.
Confirm the filtered result screen has no crash, server error, or raw invalid values.
